title: Secret in agent history
summary: An API key sits in an agent's history, transcript, paste cache, edit backups or chat database.

title: Secret in agent settings
summary: An API key sits in an agent settings or allowlist file, or inside an agent file in a package or push.

title: Over-broad agent permission
summary: An over-broad permission lets the agent run any command or skip every prompt, such as Bash(*) or bypassPermissions.

title: Agent hook calls the network
summary: An agent hook calls the network, with curl, wget, nc, a pipe into a shell, or a URL.

title: Secret inline in MCP server config
summary: An API key is written inline in an MCP server entry (env, headers, args, command or URL).

title: Agent file would ship in package
severity: high, medium or low, by file
summary: An agent file, such as .claude/settings.local.json, would ship in your npm or PyPI package.

title: Personal agent file not gitignored
summary: A personal agent file, such as CLAUDE.local.md, is in a git repo but not gitignored, or is already committed.

title: Agent data readable by other users
summary: Agent history, settings or a key store can be read by other users on this machine (macOS, Linux and Windows).

title: Package lets an AI rebuild your source
severity: high to low by licence; no licence, UNLICENSED, SEE LICENSE IN, proprietary or only LicenseRef- choices count as closed; low for a private registry
summary: Source maps, original source or AI instruction files in your package hand an AI your code.

title: Risky agent extension
severity: high; critical for a credential sent out, medium for a piped download (low in install docs), low for a stray character or an unfinished read
summary: A skill, rule, plugin or hook an agent loads has hidden characters, sends a credential out, pipes a download to a shell or hides a command.

title: MCP server runs an unpinned package
summary: An MCP server runs a package or image with no fixed version (npx, uvx, pipx run, docker run): each start gets whatever was published last.
